init_signal_handler: init the SLURM signal handler to catch SIGUSR1 and SIGTERM for job pre-emption
trigger_job_requeue: trigger a SLURM job requeue to resume training from a checkpoint file
signalHandler_SIGUSR1: handle a SIGUSR1 signal by setting the SIGNAL_RECEIVED environment variable to True
SIGTERMHandler: handle a SIGTERM signal by printing a received message for graceful shutdown
review_signal_handlers: review the SLURM signal handler functions for job pre-emption and requeue logic
